quick: Start 4 mg once daily; increase by 4 mg every 4 to 5 days
summary: Sertindole is an atypical antipsychotic with low extrapyramidal effects but marked QT prolongation. In Europe it is restricted to patients intolerant of at least one other antipsychotic, with ECG monitoring.
indications: Schizophrenia in patients intolerant of at least one other antipsychotic

dosage.d: Start 4 mg once daily; increase by 4 mg every 4 to 5 days

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Antagonist at D2, 5-HT2A and alpha-1 receptors.

absolute: Congenital or acquired QT prolongation (QTc over 450 ms men, 470 ms women)
Clinically significant heart disease or bradycardia

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
hepatic: Slower titration in mild-moderate hepatic impairment

serious: QT prolongation, torsades de pointes, sudden death

monitoring: ECG at baseline, at steady state (about 3 weeks), after each dose increase and every 3 months
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
pearls: ECG before treatment, at steady state, after each dose increase and every 3 months
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
